name: prompt-1085
image_vibe: Cute tasteful pink-studio interaction with curious forward perspective
image_purpose: Create a playful photorealistic portrait edit while preserving the approved adult subject's identity and styling.

prompt.project_info: A photorealistic edit using the required approved-adult person reference, changing only expression, pose, perspective, and background.
prompt.main_subject: The adult person from the required approved-adult reference photo. Keep the same face, facial features, skin tone, hairstyle, outfit, accessories, gender presentation, and overall likeness unchanged. Give the subject gentle eye contact, slightly raised brows, and a subtle mischievous smirk with a playful, tasteful expression.
prompt.composition_elements: The subject leans forward toward the camera like a curious cat, using a close 24-28mm wide-angle perspective with mild foreground exaggeration. Keep the face in sharp focus and replace the background with a clean solid pink seamless studio backdrop with an optional subtle gradient.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft even studio lighting, clean pink background, natural facial modeling, playful curious mood, and realistic skin and hair texture without heavy retouching.
prompt.technical_specs: 24-28mm wide-angle lens, close perspective, sharp face focus, photorealistic high-resolution edit, natural optical distortion, no explicit styling, text, watermark, or frame.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic edit using the required approved-adult person reference photo. Keep the same face, facial features, skin tone, hairstyle including color, bangs, length, and volume, outfit, accessories, gender presentation, and overall likeness unchanged; do not face-swap or create a new person. Change only the expression, pose, perspective, and background. Give the subject gentle eye contact, slightly raised brows, and a subtle mischievous smirk with a playful tasteful expression. Lean the subject forward toward the camera like a curious little cat, using a close 24-28mm wide-angle perspective with mild foreground exaggeration while keeping the face in sharp focus. Replace the background with a clean solid pink seamless studio backdrop with a very subtle gradient if needed. Use soft even lighting, natural skin and hair texture, and no explicit content, text, watermark, or frame.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, minor or teen-coded subject, identity drift, face swap, new person, changed outfit, sexualized pose, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, heavy blur, plastic skin, over-smooth, text, watermark, frame
